entities.summary: A specialist Iberian-ham shop and tasting counter built around origin selection, supervised curing and comparative tasting.
entities.description: Reserva Ibèrica’s Rambla shop is destination-worthy for people who want to understand jamón rather than simply buy a plate. The business selects 100% Iberian pieces at source, supervises curing and runs a tasting section designed to compare pieces before purchase, with additional ham-cultural activities available through the wider shop programme.
entities.whyWorthwhile: Ask for a comparative tasting of 100% acorn-fed Iberian ham rather than one anonymous plate. Compare origin, producer/cellar and cure, then use the staff recommendation to decide whether to buy sliced ham or a larger piece.
